narrative.intro: Veterans Evaluation Services has $102M in contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Veterans Evaluation Services received 4 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $25.4M. Veterans Evaluation Services obligations fell 93.9% year over year. Veterans Evaluation Services has a multiyear history of larger obligations: FY22 totaled $691M, FY23 totaled $693M, FY24 totaled $1.1B, FY25 totaled $2B, and FY26 totaled $1.7B. Veterans Evaluation Services current-year totals are partial because the period is fiscal year to date. Veterans Evaluation Services award-count and average-award-size figures describe only the current fiscal year. Veterans Evaluation Services historical obligations show a peak in FY25 at $2B, followed by a decline to $1.7B in FY26 and a further drop to $102M in FY27. Veterans Evaluation Services summary here focuses on obligations, not total contract values for listed largest awards or expiring contracts, per the note about figures and tables.
